newsitem.title: UK: UK magazine paper suppliers Salehurst to float.
newsitem.headline: UK magazine paper suppliers Salehurst to float.

text.p: Salehurst Plc, which supplies paper to more than 420 magazine titles, said on Sunday it would seek a full listing on the London Stock Exchange by way of a share placing.
It said it intended to raise two million stg net of expenses from the placing, and that in addition 2.5 million stg of existing shares will be sold.

The company said this would leave chief executive Michael Jackson and his family controlling some 55 to 60 percent of the equity, and that on flotation it was expected to be valued at between 15 and 18 million stg.
Saleshurst made a pre-tax profit of 1.75 million stg in the year ended January 31 on turnover of 28.72 million. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
